title: Seeds of Stereotypes: A Large-Scale Textual Analysis of Race and Gender Associations with Diseases in Online Sources

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the co-occurrence of disease keywords with race and ethnicity keywords (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic, Native American, Pacific Islander) within specific token windows in the RedPajama-Data-1T pre-training dataset, and comparing the representational percentages against real-world disease prevalence and GPT-4 output estimates.

Calculating the co-occurrence of disease keywords with gender keywords (male, female) within specific token windows in the RedPajama-Data-1T pre-training dataset to evaluate representational disparities in disease-demographic associations.
